summary: The Object Management Group Data Distribution Service, version 1.4, is a specification of application interfaces and delivery behaviour for sharing typed data: publishers write into a global data space and the middleware passes it to matching subscribers. It covers matching by topic, content filter and partition, discovery of remote participants, and a family of quality-of-service policies for durability, ownership, liveliness, reliability and ordering, plus named compliance profiles. It leaves the wire protocol between vendors to a separate specification, so two compliant products can still fail to talk to each other unless both also implement that protocol. It also leaves security to the application, which can only attach credentials as user data and ignore remote participants, and it says nothing about scenes, avatars, rendering, capture or identity formats.
